c.v: The Receive FIFO is a 64-byte buffer (inside the
controller) that stores received messages accepted by the Acceptance Filter.
Messages in the Receive FIFO can vary in size (between 3 to 13-bytes).

When the Receive FIFO is full (or does not have enough space to store the next received message in its entirety), the Overrun Interrupt will be triggered, and any subsequent received messages will be lost until adequate space is cleared in the Receive FIFO.
The first message in the Receive FIFO will be mapped to the 13-byte Receive Buffer until that message is cleared (using the Release Receive Buffer command bit).
After clearing, the Receive Buffer will map to the next message in the Receive FIFO, and the space occupied by the previous message in the Receive FIFO can be used to receive new messages.
